title: An update policy is not assigned to anything

messages.businessImpact: Update settings somebody configured govern nothing. The devices they were written for patch on whatever schedule they had before, and the estate is less controlled than the console suggests.
messages.technicalDetail: Covers update rings and the feature, quality and driver update policies. An unassigned policy is not an error in Intune and nothing in the console draws attention to it.
remediation: Assign each policy that is still wanted to the group it was written for.
Delete the ones that were superseded, so the console shows what is actually in force.
messages.cannotSee: Whether an unassigned policy is unfinished work or a deliberate draft cannot be told apart from outside, and a policy assigned only to an excluded group reads as assigned here.
